Yes, the current solution is to type cast a Vector type from one to another, for example:

>var a : Vector2i = Vector2i(1, 1)

> var b : Vector2 = Vector2(1, 1) * Vector2(a)

> var c : Vector2 = Vector2(1, 1) * Vector2(Vector2i(1 ,1))

But I feel this "dirties" the code base, after all you wouldn't cast a integer every time you want to multiply it with an floating point.

title: Allow for math operations between floating point and integer coordinate Vectors
